		building_dam_des_moines_rapids = must_have
		building_dam_dnieper_rapids = must_have
	}
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ai_strategy_icons/resource_expansion.dds"

	type = administrative

	building_group_weights = {
		bg_rubber = 1.5
		bg_oil_extraction = 1.5
		bg_mining = 1.5
		bg_logging = 1.5
	}


	goods_stances = {
		explosives = {
			stance = wants_high_supply
			trigger = {
				has_technology_researched = nitroglycerin
			}
		}
		tools = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		coal = { stance = wants_export }
		iron = { stance = wants_export }
		oil = { stance = wants_export }
		lead = { stance = wants_export }
		wood = { stance = wants_export }
		hardwood = { stance = wants_export }
		sulfur = { stance = wants_export }
	}


	possible = {
		always = yes
	}

	weight = {
		value = 10

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
				}
			}
			add = 20
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_radical_leftist_government = yes
				NOT = {
					ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
						is_in_government = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 25
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_country_type = unrecognized }
			multiply = 0.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = ig:ig_industrialists
				ig:ig_industrialists ?= { is_powerful = yes }
			}
			multiply = 1.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = railways
			}
			multiply = 2.0
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = overlord
				overlord = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							is_ai = no
							NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism }
						}
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_resource_expansion
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_industrial_expansion
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 2.0
		}
	}
}

	building_group_weights = {
		bg_manufacturing = 1.25
		bg_rubber = 1.25
		bg_oil_extraction = 1.25
		bg_mining = 1.25
		bg_logging = 1.25
	}

	economic_vs_government_spending_balance = { # Refer to 00_default_strategy for how this works
		if = { # Slightly more inclined to spend on economic buildings when not at war
			limit = {
				is_at_war = no
			}
			add = 0.05
		}
	}

	weight = {
		value = 10

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_north_america
				}
			}
			add = 20
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_journal_entry = je_meiji_restoration
					has_journal_entry = je_meiji_main
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = c:FRA
				c:FRA = this
				ruler = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = house_orleans
						has_variable = house_bonaparte
					}
				}
			}
			add = 20
		}

		if = { # Grunderzeit
			limit = {
				has_journal_entry = je_grunderzeit
			}
			add = 100
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_radical_leftist_government = yes
				NOT = {
					ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
						is_in_government = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}

		# Metternich agenda of 1844 - inclined to industrialise
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:AUS ?= this
				has_journal_entry = je_metternich
			}
           add = 10
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_command_economy
			}
			multiply = 2
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_country_type = unrecognized }
			multiply = 0.25
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = ig:ig_industrialists
				ig:ig_industrialists ?= { is_powerful = yes }
			}
			multiply = 2.0
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate < 0.20 }
			multiply = 0.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate < 0.40 }
			multiply = 0.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.60 }
			multiply = 1.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.80 }
			multiply = 1.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = railways
			}
			multiply = 1.5
		}
	}
}

		building_dam_dnieper_rapids = must_have
	}
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/ai_strategy_icons/placate_population.dds"

	type = administrative

	desired_tax_level = low
	max_tax_level = medium
	min_tax_level = very_low

	building_group_weights = {
		bg_agriculture = 2.0
		bg_ranching = 2.0
		bg_oil_extraction = 0.5
		bg_mining = 0.5
		bg_construction = 0.5
		bg_manufacturing = 0.25
	}

	goods_stances = {
		grain = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		meat = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		fish = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		fruit = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		fabric = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		wood = { stance = wants_high_supply }
		opium = { stance = does_not_want }
	}

	possible = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism
	}

	weight = {
		value = 10

		if = {
			limit = { is_country_type = unrecognized }
			add = 20
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate < 0.25 }
			multiply = 1.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate < 0.35 }
			multiply = 1.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = { literacy_rate >= 0.50 }
			multiply = 0.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_technology_researched = railways
			}
			multiply = 0.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
				ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { is_powerful = yes }
			}
			multiply = 1.5
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = overlord
				overlord = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							is_ai = no
							NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_traditionalism }
						}
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_resource_expansion
						has_strategy = ai_strategy_industrial_expansion
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}
}
